messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed for /v1/generate (prod us-west-2). 5xx rate = 8.7% over 5m, error spike starting ~4141239800. Impact: increased P50 latency and some gateway timeouts. Auto-pager -> @maria oncall

maria: saw it, looking. can folks post which services are showing 5xx? is this only generate or also embeddings?

sam: generate and reranking show uptick. embeddings fine. seeing a stream of 429s upstream earlier at 4141239600 then 5xx spike after retries.

nisha: that pattern smells like quota/rate limit bleed causing retries and overload. checking quota service logs now.

infra-bot: quota-service: WARN token-bucket-exhausted tenant=internal-prod rate=0.5r/s configured=0.5r/s buckets=global

maria: confirmation: gateway logs show many 429 -> client retry -> backend grpc pool exhausted -> 502/504. opening incident channel #incident-4141239999, assigning incident lead @maria.

alex: can we put a short-lived no-throttle rule for internal-prod or bump bucket to reduce retries? we should avoid full rollback if possible.

jeff: +1. I'm able to push a soft limit increase for just the affected tenant for 15m. prepping command.

maria: do it, and also enable fallback routing to secondary region (us-east-1) for generate to buy time. add any config snippets you run.

jeff: running:```bash
# temp bump global token bucket for tenant internal-prod
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/quotas/update -d '{"tenant":"internal-prod","global_burst":500,"rate":50}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -u admin-token
```

infra-bot: quota-service: INFO update accepted tenant=internal-prod rate=50r/s burst=500 by=jeff at=4141240088

sam: routing change applied: added conditional route -> us-east-1 for generate on 50% traffic. traffic shift in progress.

maria: watching metrics. 5xx trending down but still above baseline. what caused the sudden drop to 0.5r/s earlier? any deploy?

nisha: found a config push in rate-config repo at 4141239550, author=automation-ci, file=policies/global_quota.json. The change set mistakenly set global_token_bucket for multiple tenants to a low value when a template variable expanded incorrectly. diff below:

```diff
- "global_token_bucket": 10000,
+ "global_token_bucket": 1,
```

maria: that would explain the initial 429 storm. was this merged as part of the scheduled rollout?

nisha: automation pipeline applied it at 4141239565 as part of scheduled policy sync. the pipeline used a common template and a missing env var resulted in wrong substitution.

alex: so root cause: template substitution bug in quota sync pipeline -> accidentally set global token bucket to 1 -> clients hit 429 -> retries -> backend overload -> 5xx/gateway timeouts.

maria: agree. mitigation checklist: (1) revert quota change (2) throttle retries at gateway / add retry-budget (3) perform controlled rollback of pipeline template and add guardrails (4) customer comms if extended impact. status on (1) and (2)?

jeff: (1) revert done for internal-prod and rolling to other tenants now. (2) I can push a quick gateway rule to limit retry attempts and enforce exponential backoff; pushing now.

jeff:```bash
# gateway: set retry-budget to 3 attempts max and add jitter
kubectl -n gateway exec -it gateway-ctrl -- /bin/sh -c "apply-retry-policy --max-attempts=3 --jitter=0.25"
```

infra-bot: gateway: INFO retry-policy applied max_attempts=3 jitter=0.25 at=4141240260 by=jeff

sam: metrics: origin 429s dropped from 7.8% -> 0.3% over 5m after quota bump/revert. 5xx dropped from 8.7% -> 1.4%. still above baseline but stabilizing.

maria: good. begin customer impact assessment. support, can you pull list of tenants with elevated error rates and open tickets?

nisha: support list: internal-prod (high), tenant-42 (minor blips during spike), partner-A (retries observed). Outreach queued to owners: internal-prod@redwood, partner-A@partners. We should send a brief note: what happened, what we did, and ETA for postmortem.

maria: create interim status: "We detected elevated errors on text generation caused by a quota config rollout. We reverted the change and applied gateway retry limits. Services are stabilizing; we are investigating root cause and will follow with a postmortem." Send now?

sam: sent to affected owners and posted in #customers-impacted.

alex: for immediate safety, I'm adding a validation to the quota sync pipeline to reject values under a threshold (global_token_bucket < 50) and require manual approval for changes to global scope. I'll open PR and apply a hotfix to the pipeline.

maria: assign action owners and timelines in-thread:
- jeff: confirm quota rollbacks fully propagated and monitor for 30m (owner: jeff)
- alex: pipeline guard + PR in 1h and apply hotfix (owner: alex)
- nisha: compile impact list and update support notes (owner: nisha)
- sam: keep observing metrics and escalate if >2% 5xx persists (owner: sam)

jeff: confirming: rollback propagated to 99% of tenants by 4141240400. still seeing a handful of stale caches hitting the old policy -- flushing cache next.

jeff:```bash
# flush quota-service policy cache
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/quotas/flush-cache -d '{"all":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer admin-token'
```

infra-bot: quota-service: INFO cache-flush triggered at=4141240445 by=jeff

sam: metrics now P50 latency back to baseline, 5xx at 0.8%. I'll keep a 1h watch window and then start scaling back temporary routes.

maria: handoff plan: I'm oncall for another 20m, then handing to @nisha for next shift monitoring. please paste the runbook link and incident channel.

alex: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/rate-config/pull/487 - includes guard and test to fail pipeline if global_token_bucket < 50. tagging @infra-sre for quick review.

nisha: taking 1h watch after handoff, will escalate to SRE primary if >2% 5xx. prepping postmortem skeleton in docs: https://docs.internal/incidents/4141239999/postmortem-draft.md

maria: thanks team. tl;dr in one line: quota sync template bug set global bucket to 1 -> 429 flood -> retries -> backend overload -> 5xx spike. mitigated by reverting quota, bumping token bucket, retry limits, and routing.

jeff: assigning followups in tracker: QUOTA-234 (pipeline guard), QUOTA-235 (retry-budget default), COMM-98 (customer comms).

maria: closing incident channel in 2h if metrics stable. leaving thread open for final sign-off. :white_check_mark:

nisha: noted handoff. I'll post a 1h stability update and mark stable if metrics hold.

sam: watching dashboards; no new anomalies.

maria: final note for postmortem: include timeline (deploy at 4141239565, 429 start 4141239600, 5xx spike 4141239800, mitigation start 4141240088, stabilize ~4141240300), root cause, actions, preventive measures, and customer comms draft.

infra-bot: incident channel #incident-4141239999 created at=4141240012 by=maria

maria: thanks everyone. handing to @nisha in 18m.

nisha: taking over now. I'll update last_message_ts when I close the watch.

maria: :thumbsup:

nisha: STABILITY UPDATE: holding at 5xx = 0.6%, 429s < 0.2% over 15m window. marking as mitigated and will transition to postmortem. last update at 4141240520.
